text.text_excerpt: This is definitely a cool and unique venue. It reminds me of a warehouse they'd have an old school rave in back in the 90's. We came here for a conference after party, so I'm not sure we got the entire experience as if someone were here performing a concert. But I saw how useful the venue could be for different purposes. There's also a huge outdoor area that is really pretty at night. The sound in the venue seemed to be pretty clear and concise, but not too loud. I'd love to catch a show here sometime and see what it's like.

A great space for a ginormous party! I've been here for various events including San Fermin, Fashion Week New Orleans, and (most recently) The 610 Stompers Debutante Ball. The Deb Ball had outgrown its first venue the UNO Human Performance Center (though I loved it too), and has been in the Sugar Mill the last couple of years. Even with an attendance of 3,000+ you don't feel like you're vieing for air or space, in my opinion. I love the dual outdoor/indoor space. The courtyard in front isn't an afterthought. It's very well maintained and it's not just for the peeps that want to smoke. There is a ton of space. This area's great for San Fermin. I've been here multiple times for Fashion Week...

This is a very cool venue. It has a lot of open air space, but also caters to events in colder climate. They have lots of room for vendors and various types of VIP, and are close to some great bars and restaurants in the area.
